MOVE, WITH PURPOSE.
NOT JUST A RIDE. READY FOR MORE.

KuKirin C1 Max is an L1e-B electric moped designed for commuting and practical everyday utility. With up to 45km/h, a 48V 20.8Ah battery, up to 87km range, 14-inch tubeless tyres, front and rear suspension, a front basket and rear cargo capability, it is built to make both work and daily life easier.

Built for more than commuting

  • L1e-B type-approved: A two-wheel moped platform for practical urban mobility.
  • Up to 87km range: 48V 20.8Ah battery, approximately 998Wh; up to 87km in ECO, 70km in SPORT and 42km in RACE.
  • 800W rated motor: Up to 1035W instantaneous maximum power for urban routes, inclines and loaded riding.
  • Front and rear storage: A front basket plus rear cargo-box configuration for shopping, parcels and work gear.
  • Comfortable city setup: 14-inch tubeless tyres with front and rear spring suspension.
  • Three speed levels: ECO 25km/h, SPORT 35km/h and RACE 45km/h.
  • Practical lighting and braking: 160mm disc brake, LED headlight, rear light and mirrors.

Specifications

Product category L1e-B Electric Moped
Rated motor power 800W
Instantaneous maximum power 1035W
Battery 48V 20.8Ah, approximately 998Wh
Maximum speed ECO 25km/h · SPORT 35km/h · RACE 45km/h
Estimated range ECO up to 87km · SPORT up to 70km · RACE up to 42km*
Net weight 34.5 ± 0.5kg
Maximum load 140kg*
Climbing ability 17°*
Water resistance IP54
Tyres 14-inch tubeless tyres
Suspension Front and rear spring suspension
Brakes 160mm disc brake
Lighting LED headlight, rear light and mirrors
Cargo options Front basket and rear cargo-box / delivery-box configuration

Compliance and safety

KuKirin C1 Max is positioned as an L1e-B two-wheel electric moped within the EU L-category type-approval framework. Local registration, licence, insurance, helmet, age and road-use requirements may still apply. Always follow the final C1 Max type-approval documentation, Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and local law.

*Range, speed, climbing and load figures are measured under specified test conditions. Actual performance may vary with rider and load, battery level, speed, terrain, gradient, temperature, tyre pressure, wind and riding style.
